entities.summary: Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa is an Indonesian economist and engineer who has been serving as Minister of Finance since 2025 under President Prabowo Subianto. He previously served as head of the Indonesia Deposit Insurance Corporation from 2020 to 2025.
